pr_body:
Implements the Change Microphone Gain procedure

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/64363

issue_context.title: LE Audio: CAP Commander capture and rendering implementation: Change microphone gain setting
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Zephyr should be able to perform the capture and rendering Change microphone gain setting procedure for MICP.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Implement the capture and rendering Change microphone gain setting procedure for MICP as per the CAP spec. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
Section 7.3.2.6 in the CAP spec. 

Depends on https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41185

review_comments:
Since `bt_cap_common_proc_is_active` only checks if proc is active, and `bt_cap_common_start_proc` does not check this at all, there is always a risk that another process hijacks the process in between these calls.

We previously talked about a lot of the Audio API needs mutex guarding against this sort of things, so I guess we can leave this for future? 

I just wanted to point this out
Indeed. There is a potential race condition here :)
